name: Open Government Portal Canada (CKAN API)
summary: Metadata API for the Government of Canada open data catalogue: search datasets, organisations and resources over a CKAN Action API.
description: The CKAN catalogue behind open.canada.ca lists federal datasets and their downloadable resources in English and French. A package_search for 'climate' returned 2,895 datasets at check. The Action API gives dataset metadata, resource URLs, organisations and tags; datastore tables are queryable where a resource has been loaded into the DataStore.

endpoints.summary: Search dataset metadata (q, fq, rows, start, sort)
Full metadata and resource list for one dataset

agent_notes: Metadata only: follow resources[].url for the actual files. Many fields are bilingual objects ({"en":...,"fr":...}). Use rows and start to page; the license of each dataset is in license_id (most are ca-ogl-lgo).
caveats: GET only: the docs state POST with a JSON body is not supported on this portal; pass parameters in the query string.
Dataset names are often UUIDs rather than readable slugs.
Rate limits are not documented on the pages fetched.

verification.notes: Exact example request executed without a key; package_show, organization_list, package_list and tag_list also returned 200.
